!E-STHWCBK8  # D8 is not in the positioning-hole table

!E-STHWRBK  # the hole diameter D is missing
!E-STHWCK20  # no electroless-nickel compact type: the type table prints '-' for it
!E-SSTHWCBK20  # no black-oxide stainless compact type: the stainless compact type is E-SSTHWCK
!E-STHWSBK16  # no square positioning-hole type (only round and compact)
!E-STHWRB16  # not a positioning-hole type: E-STHWRB is the flanged with slit type (misumi.sth.flanged-shaft-support)
!E-STHWRBK13  # D13 is not a catalogue size
